pricing.label: Pricing
pricing.desc: No hidden fees. Cancel anytime. Annual billing saves ~20% - that's two months free.
pricing.footnote: All plans include core features. ₸ - Kaspi Pay · $ / ₽ - CryptoCloud (crypto). Purchased tokens never expire.

0.a: Through the Telegram Login Widget. No passwords, no email - one tap opens the agent with your account attached.

1.a: The free tier resets daily and weekly. Paid plans are billed monthly or annually (save ~20%). Payment is via Kaspi Pay (KZT) or CryptoCloud (crypto).

2.q: Can I use it in Russian?
2.a: Yes. Documents can be generated in English or Russian, and Scholar understands any language - queries are translated to English keywords before hitting academic indexes.

3.q: Do you store my uploaded files?
3.a: Uploaded task descriptions and reference files are used only to generate your document. Session text is stored on your account; you can delete any session at any time.

4.q: What formats do I get back?
4.a: Compiled PDF, the raw LaTeX source (.tex + bib), and a shareable public link. Visuals download as PNG with the R/Python source embedded.

5.a: Not publicly yet. If you need programmatic access for a lab or classroom, get in touch.
